ns2:course.label: Intermediate Zulu I
ns2:course.description: Survey of more advanced grammar; emphasis on increasing conversational fluency, composition skills, study of written texts in standard Zulu and discussions of grammatical variations. Same as AFST 451. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ZULU 202.
